items.reason: The only registered experimental arm is "Ipilimumab" (2 cycles); chemoradiotherapy follows only after trial treatment ends ("before continuing to standard of care treatment of debulking surgery and chemoradiation"), so it is not given within the experimental arm.

Ipilimumab is given alone as neoadjuvant trial treatment, with no other antitumour drug or radiotherapy during it; the record frames it as "the addition of ipilimumab prior to the current standard treatment", which supports reading subsequent chemoradiation as part of the regimen (C1).

note: Policy question for neoadjuvant designs: does sequential standard chemoradiation after the trial drug count toward regimen under C1? The manual does not settle sequential (non-concurrent) SOC. If yes: regimen combination, partners ["radiotherapy", "temozolomide" (not named in record)].
